claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: TG100-115 is a selective PI3K gamma/delta inhibitor with additional TRPM7 kinase activity that is not expected to kill most cancer cell lines at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would be weak and largely cytostatic rather than broadly cytotoxic.
